name: new-tool-forms
what: The command-line forms that were missing, performed by their components' own adapters on the machine the test runs on: tur-device list, with and without categories the model names; tur-device get for an identifier no device has; tur-storage decide for a volume the machine does not have; and tur-storage volumes, which now asks lsblk itself.
request: Which devices and volumes does this computer have?

turns.text: I will list the devices and the volumes.
The devices and the volumes are listed above. One device and one volume I asked about do not exist.
